title: Haunts
summary: Places the dead hold as their own.

claims.text: Haunts are where the Gothic side of the world rules: ruined chapels, old towers and decaying mansions, steeped in half-forgotten lives, where the living feel they are trespassing and death holds sway.

title: Providence of the dead
summary: A New England city ruled by a Hierarchy family.

claims.text: Providence has long been a home for horror, and its ghosts know Brown University and the Italian neighborhoods around a ruined church spire; even Kindred tread lightly there.
Ambrose Tillinghast rules the dead of Providence with the force of the Hierarchy and the spirits of the Tillinghast family behind that rule.

A white three-storey Colonial house on campus is shown to visitors as a landmark; guides tell of shifting chalk outlines, figures at windows and a dripping ghost calling for Sarey, and its attic has never been opened.
Hermitage Castle stands alone in the border country between Scotland and England, about fifty miles from Edinburgh near Hawick, its grounds soaked in centuries of bloodshed.
The ancestral home of Lord Soulis has no Renegades or Heretics among its dead, only the iron rule of the Hierarchy, where weakness means destruction.

title: Atlantic City
summary: A gambling town that drew the dead.

claims.text: Few Restless gathered in Atlantic City until gambling was made legal there in 1980; before that its dead were mostly Enfants and old wraiths bound to happier summers, ignored by Hierarchy and Heretic alike.
Some say vampires with money in the city pushed legal gambling, others blame Technomancers.

title: The Children of the Flesh
summary: A Heretic Circle that keeps bodies for the Resurrection.

claims.text: Santo Domingos took the title of saint, wrote the Tome of Os from a claimed vision, and founded the Children of the Flesh to claim and preserve bodies for a Day of Resurrection.
Its members long for physical life and reject both the Far Shores and the Void; the living world is all that counts to them.

title: Teach's Hole
summary: Blackbeard's Haunt on a Wyld-touched island.

claims.text: Wyld energy keeps most buildings and technology on the island from showing in the Shadowlands; the Coast Guard station appears half-sunk, and a graveyard shows with every marker in place.

The only dead on the island gather at Teach's Hole, Blackbeard's Haunt, where a pirate gang of Renegades called the Brethren of the Tempest camp and party on the beaches, out of the Hierarchy's reach.

title: Khatyn Mir
summary: A sanctuary of the dead in a destroyed Belarusian village.

claims.text: The village of Khatyn, destroyed by the Nazis, is a sanctuary of the dead; Adas Kaminsky, who looks like a small child, gathered its citizens and is known to most Belarusians among the dead.
A small secret Heretic group worships the village as the center of the Shadowlands; Renegades are welcomed, though a few abuse the sanctuary.
